integrity: The proof is a direct induction on the nonlinear squaring map on the intrinsic two-dimensional square. Computational tests independently use the natural-basis multiplication and do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the displayed three-dimensional evolution-algebra family over odd finite fields is classified.
The results concern nonlinear elementwise squaring, not the linear natural-basis evolution operator.
Preperiodic tail lengths, characteristic two, and arbitrary evolution algebras are not classified.
Independent audit and comprehensive historical priority certification have not been performed.
title: Exact periodic squaring spectra of the Hu–Wen evolution-algebra family over odd finite fields
